channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Senate Control After the Midterms: Party Switches, Ties and Wild Cards
item.description: The likelihood of a slim majority leaves room for several hard-to-predict scenarios that could affect the balance of power.

item.title: NPR: Judge accuses DOJ of 'weaponization,' tosses case against ex-FBI officials
item.description: The judge said he was "deeply troubled" by the mistakes and rushed nature of the case over the FBI's Hunter Biden probes — one of several politically charged DOJ actions ahead of the midterms.

item.title: BBC News: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
item.description: The temperature of freezers in several shops across Europe reportedly rose to as high as 50C.

item.title: The Guardian: Five dimensional chess: inside James Talarico’s extraordinary bid to break Texas Democrats’ losing streak
item.description: The Texan could pull off a historic victory in the Lone Star state, which hasn’t elected a Democratic senator since 1988 When a young, untested former school teacher stood up to address a modest gathering of local donors…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Lindsay Clancy in court to drop child murder charges after mistrial
item.description: Defence argues juror misconduct and judge's questioning impacted Clancy's trial for strangling of her three children.

item.title: Ars Technica: Coming in 2027: Apple’s $1,000 home robot for FaceTime and switching on lights
item.description: Apple robot backed by CEO John Ternus may have hefty price tag and limited uses.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: I Gave My Blood to the AI Death Clock
item.description: Death Clock promises to predict when you’re going to die and help you extend your time on Earth. After a month, I felt like it was sucking the life out of me.

item.title: WIRED Science: Chatbots Are Leading Hikers Astray, With Dangerous Consequences
item.description: Outsourcing planning to AI can lead people to surrender their own critical thinking, which can have potentially deadly results in places like the backcountry.

item.title: WIRED Business: Meta’s Muse Could Upend All Kinds of Businesses. It Hasn’t Yet
item.description: Companies have spent the past several weeks trying to reassure investors that Muse and other AI agents pose more of an opportunity than a threat.

item.title: The New Yorker: An Exiled Filmmaker’s Unsparing View of Contemporary Russia
item.description: Andrey Zvyagintsev’s “Minotaur” is the first independent feature to portray Russian life during the war with Ukraine.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: The Best Gift Ideas Under $50 This Holiday Season
item.description: Options for everyone from your bestie to your dad.

item.description: And a two-bedroom with additional office potential in prime Prospect Heights
